cases.title: WHY ORIONIS
cases.body: Most businesses are handed the same generic website or software — like prescribing paracetamol for every illness. At Orionis we diagnose first. We learn where your real problem is, then build dedicated software, websites and automation around it. Not a vendor — a technology partner that grows with you.

cases.title: AI INVOICE AGENT
cases.body: A freight forwarder was keying in 3,000+ invoices a month by hand. We built an AI document-intelligence agent that reads, validates and posts each invoice straight into their ERP, flagging only the exceptions for a human. Processing time dropped from four days to six hours, and data-entry errors fell by 80%.

cases.title: TELEHEALTH APP
cases.body: A network of clinics needed patients to book, pay and meet doctors online. We designed a cross-platform iOS and Android app with a matching web portal — live slot booking, secure video consults and digital prescriptions. Over 40,000 consultations were booked in the first six months.

cases.title: CLOUD MIGRATION
cases.body: An online marketplace kept crashing on flash-sale days. We migrated it to auto-scaling cloud infrastructure defined as code, with CI/CD pipelines and 24/7 monitoring. The next mega-sale handled 12x normal traffic with zero downtime — and monthly hosting costs fell by 35%.

cases.title: RETAIL DATA HUB
cases.body: A fashion retailer had sales, ads and inventory data in six disconnected tools. We built a data pipeline and live BI dashboards with marketing attribution, so every campaign's true ROI is visible by morning. Ad spend was re-balanced within weeks, lifting return on ad spend by 2.3x.

script.text: Hi there! I'm Orion, and welcome to Orionis Tech.

Custom software. Websites and mobile apps. And AI automations that keep working while you sleep.
We move you to the cloud, connect your data, and build custom solutions for problems nobody else has solved.
No templates. No generic fixes. Every solution is tailored to how your business really works.
We plan, we build, we scale, and we stay with you to maintain it, for the long term.
Tap the cards around me to explore our work, or tap a service on the ring to watch it come to life.
